title: Chemical Drain Cleaners Fix All Clogs
description: Many homeowners and inexperienced technicians rely on chemical drain cleaners as a quick fix for blocked drains. However, chemical cleaners often cause more harm than good. They rely on exothermic reactions or harsh caustics that can soften or warp PVC piping, corrode older cast iron and galvanized pipes, and create severe hazards for plumbers performing mechanical snaking later. In cases of severe grease buildup or physical blockages, chemical cleaners rarely clear the full pipe diameter. Professional drain cleaning relies on mechanical augers or hydro-jetting to restore flow safely without compromising the integrity of the drainage network.

Chemical Drain Cleaners Fix All Clogs

Many homeowners and inexperienced technicians rely on chemical drain cleaners as a quick fix for blocked drains. However, chemical cleaners often cause more harm than good. They rely on exothermic reactions or harsh caustics that can soften or warp PVC piping, corrode older cast iron and galvanized pipes, and create severe hazards for plumbers performing mechanical snaking later. In cases of severe grease buildup or physical blockages, chemical cleaners rarely clear the full pipe diameter. Professional drain cleaning relies on mechanical augers or hydro-jetting to restore flow safely without compromising the integrity of the drainage network.
